projects.title: EstateWise – AI-Powered Real Estate Assistant for Chapel Hill, NC
projects.description:
EstateWise is a full-stack real estate chatbot that delivers personalized property recommendations using agentic AI, MCP, Neo4j, RAG, kNN, MoE, and CoT. Designed for users in Chapel Hill, NC, it blends intelligent search with a smooth interface and secure user auth.

Key Features:
- UI/UX: Built with Next.js, React, Tailwind, & Shadcn. Supports both guest and authenticated modes with a polished and responsive chat experience.
- Secure Auth & Convo Management: JWT-based login with MongoDB. Authenticated users can manage chat history; guest sessions persist via localStorage.
- AI Recommendations (RAG + kNN): Embedded 30k+ Pinecone vectors via cosine similarity. Results are injected into chatbot context.
- Real-Time k-Means Clustering: Property listings are normalized and clustered to uncover submarkets and provide structured insights.
- Mixture-of-Experts: 5 specialized AI agents (e.g., Financial Advisor, Neighborhood Expert) generate responses with a Master Merger model.
- Chain-of-Thought: Each expert uses CoT to break down complex queries into manageable steps, ensuring accurate and relevant responses.
- Agentic AI Pipeline: Consists of an orchestrator, LangGraph, and CrewAI runtimes to coordinate specialized agents (analytics, graph, finance, property).
- Deal Analyzer: Utilizes AI/ML to evaluate if a property is a good deal based on historical trends, neighborhood data, and market conditions.
- Charts: Features trends, distributions, and cluster breakdowns across the app.
- Feedback-Driven Expert Weighting: Users rate responses with thumbs-up/thumbs-down buttons, adjusting expert influence in real time for improved personalization.
- Backend API: Express + TS backend with Swagger, MongoDB, Pinecone, and Prometheus monitoring.
- Python Notebook: Colab notebook supports EDA, clustering, maps, and a CLI chatbot, bridging engineering and data science.

projects.title: The MovieVerse – Your Ultimate Movie Database
projects.description:
This web application is a comprehensive database of movies, with more than 1 million movies from around the world. It currently houses 330,000+ monthly users and 2M+ ratings/reviews/comments so far. Live: https://movie-verse.com.

Key Features:
- Search & Discover: Users can quickly search for movies, TV shows, actors, & directors and access detailed information about them.
- User Interaction: Users can rate movies, write reviews, manage watchlists, and engage with other movie enthusiasts in a dynamic community.
- Personalized Experience: Users can get AI-powered movie recommendations based on preferences and ratings, create a personalized profile, and explore a customized movie timeline.
- Multi-Platform Compatibility: Users can enjoy a seamless experience across various devices with a responsive design optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- Global Engagement: Users can translate various info into multiple languages & chat in real-time with other users.

Development:
- Microservices Architecture: Allows each service to be independently developed, deployed, and scaled.
- Database Management: Uses 4 databases (MongoDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL) & message broker (RabbitMQ) for efficient data storage and communication across different services.
- Frameworks: Django & Flask are used to handle API requests, data processing, user management, & backend functionalities, using the MVC architecture.
- Machine Learning and AI: Uses AI/ML for advanced movie data processing, AI-powered recommendations, & dynamically updating the database with new movie data from online sources.
- Crawler Service: A custom web crawler that dynamically collects and updates movie data from various sources using BeautifulSoup4, Requests, Transformers, & PyTorch.
- Responsive & Dynamic UI: Built with the MPA architecture to provide a dynamic and responsive user interface optimized for all devices.
- Mobile Version: Built with Apache Cordova & designed to work well with iOS and Android devices.
